name: myspec-factory
description: Turns Claude Code into a Software Factory Manager that runs a MySpec specification bundle to completion with a team of long-lived Claude Code agents: groups related tasks from tasks.md, divides them evenly by size between a team of cloud sessions (or local sessions), hands each agent one group at a time and rebalances when one runs dry, integrates the resulting pull requests, marks tasks done on MySpec, and stops at milestone gates. Listens to the MySpec project event feed through a stream token and Claude Code's Monitor tool. Includes the Software Factory Manager output style and a scheduled factory shift.
